test(markup): pin a negated attribute byte for byte against the reference (rich-color-9ga) (#201)

* test(markup): pin a negated attribute byte for byte against the reference (rich-color-9ga)

The SGR 22 the ticket measured was already gone: a5ef4b92 (#117) made
Style.toSgrCodes write only the attributes that are on. Nothing pinned it.
negated-attribute puts [bold red]a[not bold]b[/not bold]c[/] in the
reference-generated golden, regenerated with the header's own command so
every existing case reproduced unchanged. Mutating toSgrCodes to emit 22
for a false attribute turns it red.

The ticket's own [red]..[not bold] shape cannot go in yet: the encoder
merges adjacent equal-SGR runs where Rich writes one per segment. Filed
as rich-render-g5g8.

* test(style): pin that a negated attribute writes no SGR parameter (rich-color-9ga)

Rows checked against Rich 9d8f9a3 _make_ansi_codes. The markup comment
now credits the fix to rich-style-h93 (#117), where it landed.

test(link): pin nested and wrap-split links as one id per link (rich-link-jkh) (#200)

* test(link): pin a nested and a wrap-split link as one id per link, end to end (rich-link-jkh)

The id itself landed in #152; this pins the ticket's end state through
Console.print: the outer link repeats its id around a nested one, as
Rich's does, and every line of a wrapped link opens with one id.

* test(link): pin exact runs per line, compare (uri, id) pairs, anchor the Rich claim (rich-link-jkh)

fix(table): a NaN column bound is no bound, parsed where it enters the column (rich-table-hge)

A minWidth or maxWidth of NaN reached Math.max/Math.min in _naturalWidth,
poisoned the natural width, and erased the whole column. The bounds are now
accessors that hold NaN as undefined, so the guarantee holds for a bound
assigned after construction too. Infinity stays a real bound. The existing
'treats NaN column bounds as no bounds' test asserted the collapsed frame;
it now asserts the content-sized one its name promises.
